description: Search or fetch client records by name/email text or by client ids (max 20 ids) — contact details, status, alerts, home location. Requires a staff user token. Mindbody: GET /client/clients.

is_prospect.description: true = only prospects; false = only non-prospects.

last_modified_date.description: Only clients modified on or after this date — ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-10-01 or 2026-10-01T09:00:00.

offset.description: Page offset (request.offset). Mindbody defaults to 0. See PaginationResponse.TotalResults.

search_text.description: Match against first name, last name and email.

name: mindbody_list_clients
title: Search clients
